sentences.en: But, above all, the central figure of his book redeems it from the possibility of the charge of being commonplace or ignoble.

sentences.en: Civilization is a conditioned mediate tendency to perfection, to which religion is the final completion if carried out; it is the end of the second cycle expressed by the second formula, the Ens redeems existences.

sentences.en: But, since there are 3 different endings (ranging from intense to mediocre), the game redeems itself quickly when the holes are fixed and you make it to the finish.
